title: Integration Architecture Guardrails Catalogue
description: Catalogue of non-negotiable constraints, mandatory standards, and concrete patterns for the Integration architecture domain. Aligned to Policy-as-Code conventions (AWS Service Control Policies, Azure Policy).

meta.description: Rules and minimum standards that must be followed in Integration Architecture.
purpose: Protects the architecture from integration patterns that introduce unacceptable risk
Codifies security and compliance requirements at the integration layer
Provides enforceable standards for API design, authentication, and data in transit
Enables automated guardrail checking during integration decision review
Prevents accumulation of integration debt caused by rule exceptions

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

audience.description: Roles this artefact is written for (its readers).

author.description: Roles responsible for authoring and maintaining this artefact.

rule.description: The mandatory constraint or required pattern

rationale.description: Why this is mandatory — often references a principle or compliance requirement

exception-process.description: How an exception can be raised (or 'No exceptions')

decision-id.description: ID of the ADR whose committed changes produced this activity entry (e.g. ADR-014), when the change was applied via a decision.
